mapper.sql:
FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=i.product_model_id LEFT JOIN bike_domestic_sku_order d ON d.order_id=o.id WHERE o.customer_id=#{customerId} AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_SHIPPED') AND i.ordered_qty>i.shipped_qty
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR (d.order_id IS NULL AND m.model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_order_reservation_item si JOIN bike_production_sku s ON s.id=si.sku_id JOIN bike_product_model sm ON sm.id=s.model_id WHERE si.order_id=d.order_id AND (s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR sm.model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))))
mapper.select:
SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,CASE WHEN d.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_order_reservation_item si WHERE si.order_id=o.id),' SKU') ELSE m.model_name END model_name,i.ordered_qty order_qty,i.shipped_qty,o.status
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
